### PA_MSQ_H1: Select all neuroglial cells residing in Central Nervous System (CNS): (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Astrocytes
- [ ] B) Oligodendrocytes
- [ ] C) Microglia
- [ ] D) Ependymal cells
- [ ] E) Schwann cells

> **✅ Answers:** A) Astrocytes, B) Oligodendrocytes, C) Microglia, D) Ependymal cells
> **Explanation:** CNS neuroglia = Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes, Microglia, Ependymal. Schwann = PNS.

### PA_MSQ_H2: Select all characteristics belonging to Red Muscle fibres: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) High myoglobin content
- [ ] B) Rich blood capillary network
- [ ] C) Abundant mitochondria
- [ ] D) Fast-twitch rapid fatigue
- [ ] E) Aerobic respiration

> **✅ Answers:** A) High myoglobin content, B) Rich blood capillary network, C) Abundant mitochondria, E) Aerobic respiration
> **Explanation:** Red muscle is rich in myoglobin/mitochondria, slow-twitch, aerobic.

### PA_MSQ_H3: Select all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Kupffer cells (Liver)
- [ ] B) Microglia (Brain)
- [ ] C) Dust cells (Lungs)
- [ ] D) Langerhans cells (Skin)
- [ ] E) Chondrocytes

> **✅ Answers:** A) Kupffer cells (Liver), B) Microglia (Brain), C) Dust cells (Lungs), D) Langerhans cells (Skin)
> **Explanation:** Kupffer, Microglia, Dust cells, Langerhans are monocyte-derived histocytes.

### PA_MSQ_H4: Select all features distinguishing Cardiac Muscle from Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Involuntary autonomic control
- [ ] B) Branched cardiocyte arrangement
- [ ] C) Presence of Intercalated Discs
- [ ] D) Resistance to fatigue
- [ ] E) Syncytial multinucleated fibers

> **✅ Answers:** A) Involuntary autonomic control, B) Branched cardiocyte arrangement, C) Presence of Intercalated Discs, D) Resistance to fatigue
> **Explanation:** Cardiac muscle is involuntary, branched, has intercalated discs, fatigue-resistant.

### PA_MSQ_H5: Select all factors required during blood clotting cascade to form Fibrin: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Calcium ions (Ca2+)
- [ ] B) Thromboplastin
- [ ] C) Prothrombin
- [ ] D) Fibrinogen
- [ ] E) Heparin

> **✅ Answers:** A) Calcium ions (Ca2+), B) Thromboplastin, C) Prothrombin, D) Fibrinogen
> **Explanation:** Clotting requires Thromboplastin, Ca2+, Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen.

### PA_MSQ_H6: Select all true features of White Adipose Tissue vs Brown Adipose Tissue: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
- [ ] B) Brown fat contains high density of cytochrome mitochondria
- [ ] C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1) for heat generation
- [ ] D) White fat serves as primary long-term energy reservoir
- [ ] E) White fat generates heat in hibernating newborn mammals

> **✅ Answers:** A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular, B) Brown fat contains high density of cytochrome mitochondria, C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1) for heat generation, D) White fat serves as primary long-term energy reservoir
> **Explanation:** Brown fat is multilocular, rich in mitochondria/UCP-1 for thermogenesis; White fat is monolocular energy storage.

### PA_MSQ_H7: Select all ultrastructural events occurring in Sarcomere during Skeletal Muscle contraction: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Shortening of I-band length
- [ ] B) Disappearance or narrowing of H-zone
- [ ] C) Constant length of A-band
- [ ] D) Approximation of adjacent Z-lines
- [ ] E) Elongation of Myosin thick filaments

> **✅ Answers:** A) Shortening of I-band length, B) Disappearance or narrowing of H-zone, C) Constant length of A-band, D) Approximation of adjacent Z-lines
> **Explanation:** During contraction, I-band and H-zone shorten, Z-lines move closer, while A-band remains constant.

### PA_MSQ_H8: Select all structural characteristics of Myelinated Axons in peripheral nerves: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Concentric myelin wraps formed by Schwann cells
- [ ] B) Saltatory action potential propagation across Nodes of Ranvier
- [ ] C) High concentration of voltage-gated Na+ channels at Nodes
- [ ] D) Increased nerve impulse conduction velocity
- [ ] E) Continuous slow wave uninsulated axon depolarization

> **✅ Answers:** A) Concentric myelin wraps formed by Schwann cells, B) Saltatory action potential propagation across Nodes of Ranvier, C) High concentration of voltage-gated Na+ channels at Nodes, D) Increased nerve impulse conduction velocity
> **Explanation:** Myelinated nerve fibers feature Schwann myelin wraps, high Na+ channel density at Nodes, and fast saltatory conduction.

### PA_MSQ_H9: Select all properties distinguishing Fibrocartilage from Hyaline Cartilage: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Abundant parallel bundles of Type I collagen fibers
- [ ] B) Highest tensile strength among all cartilage types
- [ ] C) Absence of perichondrium sheath
- [ ] D) Located in intervertebral discs and pubic symphysis
- [ ] E) Smooth glass-like transparent matrix with Type II collagen

> **✅ Answers:** A) Abundant parallel bundles of Type I collagen fibers, B) Highest tensile strength among all cartilage types, C) Absence of perichondrium sheath, D) Located in intervertebral discs and pubic symphysis
> **Explanation:** Fibrocartilage has Type I collagen bundles, high tensile strength, lacks perichondrium, and forms intervertebral discs.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Select all properties distinguishing Fib" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PA_MSQ_H10: Select all cell types in Connective Tissue Proper derived from mesenchyme lineage: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Matrix-producing Fibroblasts
- [ ] B) Histamine-releasing Mast cells
- [ ] C) Antibody-producing Plasma cells derived from B-lymphocytes
- [ ] D) Phagocytic Histocytes / Macrophages
- [ ] E) Keratin-synthesizing Epidermal Keratinocytes

> **✅ Answers:** A) Matrix-producing Fibroblasts, B) Histamine-releasing Mast cells, C) Antibody-producing Plasma cells derived from B-lymphocytes, D) Phagocytic Histocytes / Macrophages
> **Explanation:** Fibroblasts, Mast cells, Plasma cells, and Macrophages are mesenchymal connective tissue cells.
